title: Bicycles Outside American Bungalow Home, 1940s Elko Snapshot Photo
description: A quaint black-and-white snapshot of a single-story clapboard cottage or craftsman-style bungalow with a gabled front porch. Parked near the porch are two vintage balloon-tire bicycles, conveying a peaceful slice of mid-20th-century American neighborhood life. The print is framed by a decorative geometric art deco border bearing the brand name 'ELKO' in the corners, typical of commercial film developing from the late 1930s into the 1940s.
